questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure (the author contributions mention "devices"), and how many showed the e/4 gate period?
Why were the others set aside, and over how many cooldowns was this device measured?

Which side-gate, displacement-field and field ranges did you measure at ν = −5/2, −1/2 and 3/2 beyond the Fig. 2 windows, over what side-gate range does the e/4 period hold, and which excitation current did you use at each state?
What does the second-best dataset at each even-denominator state look like, for example a repeat of the faint ν = −5/2 map (Fig. S8, p. 20)?
Could you repeat fixed-field gate sweeps at ν = −5/2, −1/2 and 3/2 as in Fig. S13, and report the air-bridge gate leakage at base temperature?

∆V1 comes from ν = −1 at 10 T, while the half-filled states sit at 14 T, in the N = 1 level and at other displacement fields (Fig. 1d); how does the ADG lever arm depend on D and Landau level, and could a reference state at each state's D and field confirm it?
Can you identify the regime independently of the period ratios, from the stripe slope sign in the Fig. 2 maps or a charging energy from the DC-bias maps (Figs. S8c to S11c)?

The e/4 suppression temperature reads "approximately 60 mK" (p. 8), "between 50 mK and 70 mK" (p. 28) and "30 mK to 50 mK" (p. 30), and the doubled period at ν = 2/3 also survives to 120 mK (p. 28); which values hold, and does that change the p. 8 argument singling out ν = −1/2?
